thread_text:
nina: Drafting RN + internal announce for v2.3.1. Change window Thu 23:00 UTC. Need a one-paragraph blurb, exact deploybot commands, pin header, and rollback bullets. Who can review quickly?

sam: I can review. Add Dedicated pin header and SDK snippet.

lee: Canary plan: 10% 20m -> 50% 20m -> 100% 20m. Health gates: error_rate > 1.5% (5m) or p95 + 90ms => pause. OOM spike = immediate pause + rollback.

juan: +1. Include OOM_count > 0 as a hard trigger. Also add an ops checklist with copy/paste commands.

maria: Blurb draft: "v2.3.1: KV-cache fixes, streaming efficiency (~10% token cost), and a quant stability patch. Canary tonight; oncall: @lee @juan. See RN for rollback runbook and pin info."

nina: Nice. Pin header: `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f`. Fallback runtime: `rif-quant-v2`. I'll include SDK examples for curl and node.

deploybot: Suggested command: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10% --stages=50%,100% --stage-duration=20m`

opsbot: Automation triggers saved: error_rate > 1.5% (5m), p95_delta > 90ms (5m), oom_count > 0 (3m). Auto-rollback if two triggers fire within 5m.

sam: Rollback snippet for RN: ```bash
# Pause canary
deploybot pause --id {{deploy_id}}
# Rollback to previous
deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0
``` Keep it copy/paste.

lee: Add observability queries: `runtime_errors: rate(5m)` and `request_duration_p95: p95(5m)` so oncall can eyeball quickly.

nina: Draft posted: https://rwd.internal/releases/drafts/v2.3.1-rn-quickreview — will send internal announce 20m before window (22:40 UTC) unless objections.

juan: LGTM. I'll be oncall for the window.

deploybot: Canary started (10%) -> monitoring active. Good luck! :rocket:
